name: ATLAS-120k
bullets: Size: 121,018 annotated frames from 100 surgical videos
Procedures covered: 14 laparoscopic and robot-assisted procedures with 41 classes
What sets it apart: Clip-level semantic segmentation dataset created with a pipeline combining manual labeling, tracker-based propagation, and surgeon review

name: Reporting completeness of robot-assisted and laparoscopic partial nephrectomy videos on YouTube
bullets: Contains 248 YouTube videos of robot-assisted and laparoscopic partial nephrectomy
Includes video identifiers, URLs, channel classification, surgical approach, upload date, duration, views, and likes
Features item-level scores for the adapted 16-item LAP-VEGaS checklist, JAMA, modified DISCERN, and Global Quality Score totals
Includes Python scripts to reproduce all analyses reported in the associated article

name: Force-Maximum Interpretability and Rapid Load Decreases in Archived Ex Vivo Porcine Colon Puncture Waveforms
bullets: Contains 162 ex vivo porcine-colon puncture force-time recordings acquired under varying forceps-shaft inclinations and carriage speeds.
Includes Python analysis scripts, source and derived CSV datasets, supplementary tables, and reproduction instructions.
Features descriptive analyses of force maxima, postmaximum force-indication decreases, and negative indications.
